claims.statement: Assignment starter templates are optional but must be organization-owned or public on GitHub. Public visibility is not license clearance, safe execution or authorization to copy upstream expression, and organization ownership does not prove pedagogical suitability. The linked creation article and current post-sunset availability remain separate.

A feedback PR can be automatically created to provide feedback and answer student questions. PR creation is not proof of meaningful comments, completed review, grading or student acknowledgment; the generic review link does not inherit full review.
